faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Irish Setter?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 50-70 lb (23-32 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a adult Irish Setter?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Hip dysplasia; Progressive retinal atrophy (PRA); Hypothyroidism. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.question: How often should I weigh my Irish Setter at this stage?
faqs.answer: Every 30 days is a practical adult Irish Setter default unless your veterinarian sets a tighter plan.
